content.body:
This Hotchkiss-made anti-aircraft gun was used by many countries in WWII and is more properly known as the Mitrailleuse de 25 mm CA mle 38. It was a stable platform with an accurate and reliable gun. It proved to be an excellent anti-aircraft weapon. The British swapped a shipment of Boys ATR's for these AA guns, which they used in France. The gun is quick to deploy into action against enemy aircraft. For a light AA gun, the CA mle 38 has a powerful high-explosive charge and can bring enemy planes down very quickly, if they are within its effective range.
In Battleground Europe you should deploy this gun to provide a close-in anti-air umbrella over attacking forces. Try to set up in a brush line or in trees behind your main advance, where your HE firepower will not only be useful against enemy aircraft, but can provide heavy fire-support for your advancing infantry.
When undeployed you are able to move rather quickly, so don’t hesitate to relocate frequently. Redeploying is the best way to prevent enemy air and ground forces pinpointing your location.
CREW POSITIONS: 1 Commander 2 Gunner
content.brief: TYPE: Light Anti-Aircraft Gun CALIBER: 25 mm MUZZLE VELOCITY: 900 m/s EFFECTIVE RANGE: 800 m WEIGHT: 155 kg TOWING CLASS: Light
content.title: Hotchkiss 25 mm CA mle 38 Anti-Aircraft Gun
